diagnostics.message: google_organization_iam_binding.authoritative binds roles from var.iam, which may include custom roles created by google_organization_iam_custom_role.roles in this same module. Granting a role requires the custom role to already exist (and role changes propagate asynchronously), but no attribute reference or depends_on orders the binding after the role, so an apply can fail with a "role not found"/propagation error. Add an explicit dependency on google_organization_iam_custom_role.roles.

google_organization_iam_member.additive grants roles from var.iam_additive / var.iam_additive_members, which can be custom roles created by google_organization_iam_custom_role.roles in this module. IAM member creation requires the referenced role to exist first; nothing establishes that ordering, so the module can race custom-role creation and fail. Add an explicit dependency on google_organization_iam_custom_role.roles.

google_organization_iam_policy.authoritative applies an authoritative policy whose bindings come from var.iam_bindings_authoritative, which can include custom roles created by google_organization_iam_custom_role.roles. The whole policy cannot be applied until those custom roles exist, but the policy only depends on the local data source/var and has no ordering to the role resource. Add an explicit dependency on google_organization_iam_custom_role.roles.
